newsitem.title: USA: US jet fuel jump soars with NYMEX, diffs stable.
newsitem.headline: US jet fuel jump soars with NYMEX, diffs stable.

text.p: U.S. spot jet fuel prices jumped over one cent by late Wednesday in tandem with NYMEX November heating oil, as differentials held stable in both centers, players said.
New York Harbor 54-grade jet was offered at about 1.0 cent over the print, with 55-grade low sulfur fuel diffs also steady at 5.75 cents over.
Gulf Coast 54-grade back-28th cycle material was pegged at 1.75 cents below November futures, with 55-grade firming 0.25 cent to 1.25 cents over the screen.
